tour.stage_body: Calm means nothing needs you. It turns worried for a warning and alarmed when something is ringing.
tour.topics_body:
A topic is one alarm line. Your server sends it a message and your phone rings.
• Calm face: all quiet
• Red, alarmed face: something is ringing now
• payments-api is only an example. It goes away after the tour.
tour.topics_body_example:
A topic is one alarm line. Your server sends it a message and your phone rings.
• Calm face: all quiet
• Red, alarmed face: something is ringing now
• All three are examples. They go away after the tour.
tour.compose_body: Tap + to create a new topic. Make one for each thing you watch.
tour.create_name_body: Name it after what it watches, like prod-db or backups. The name is also its address: your server posts to /prod-db.
tour.create_critical_body: Turn critical delivery on for pages that must wake you. Leave it off for everything else. You can change it later.
tour.create_button_body: Tap Create and Crit Alarm shows the topic's address and token. The token shows once, so copy it into your script straight away.
tour.search_body:
One search looks through:
• Topics, like "prod"
• Past alarms, like "yesterday"
• Settings, like "sound"
• The docs, like "docker"
tour.search_settings_body: Type "sound" to jump to the alarm sound, or "dark" for the theme. No digging through menus.
tour.search_docs_body: Type "uptime kuma" or "docker" to open a setup guide from critalarm.app.
tour.topic_critical_body:
• On: rings like an alarm, even on silent, until you stop it
• Off: a normal notification that follows your phone's sound settings
tour.topic_sound_body: Choose the alarm sound for this topic. The default for every topic lives in Settings.
tour.topic_delete_body: Down here at the bottom. It removes the topic for good, and its address and tokens stop working.
tour.history_body: Every alarm ends up here, with when it rang and when it was stopped.
tour.health_body: Shows whether anything on this phone would stop an alarm from reaching you. A red dot on Settings means something needs fixing.
tour.replay_body: Each screen shows its own short guide the first time you open it. Tap How to use the app any time to see them all again.
tour.example_topic_sub: Example topic. Nothing here is real.
tour.example_message_body: db-1 is at 92% disk. Sent by your monitor.

home.title: Crit Alarm
home.stage_sub_no_topics: Create one, then point a script, cron job or monitor at its endpoint.
home.detail_empty_body: Pick a topic to see its details.
home.server_banner_body: Crit Alarm cannot receive alarms without a server. Connect to Crit Alarm Cloud or point to your own.
home.account_prompt_body: Sign in to keep your topics safe if you switch or lose your device.
home.pro_prompt_subtitle: Support solo development and remove limits:
home.pro_prompt_fed: Going Pro keeps a solo developer fed.
home.stage_sub_no_server: Connect a server and your topics load from it.
home.stage_sub_unreachable: This is what it looked like at {time}.
home.unreachable_strip: Cannot reach the server. Last seen {time}.
home.pro_ending_body:
After that:
• Home screen widgets lock
• History keeps {history_days} days
• {p4_daily} low-priority pushes a day
• No new critical topics past {critical_topics}

Your alarms keep ringing.
home.pro_ended_body:
Your alarms keep ringing.

What changed:
• Home screen widgets are locked
• History keeps {history_days} days
• {p4_daily} low-priority pushes a day
• No new critical topics past {critical_topics}
